# llms.txt for Connect.Sampidia.com
# Version: 1.0
# Last Updated: 2026-02-12

========================================
OVERVIEW
========================================

Connect.Sampidia.com is a community and networking platform operated by the Sampidia brand. The platform enables users to interact, collaborate, share ideas, participate in discussions, and build professional or educational connections.

----------------------------------------

========================================
PRIMARY PURPOSE
========================================

The platform exists to:

- Enable community discussions
- Provide networking opportunities
- Support educational and professional collaboration
- Allow knowledge sharing among users
- Facilitate user engagement within the Sampidia ecosystem

----------------------------------------

========================================
TARGET AUDIENCE
========================================

- Students and graduates
- Professionals and freelancers
- Technology and AI enthusiasts
- Sampidia community members
- Users seeking collaboration opportunities

----------------------------------------

========================================
CONTENT TYPES
========================================

1. Community discussions
2. User-generated posts and comments
3. Educational collaboration discussions
4. Professional networking conversations
5. Platform announcements and updates

----------------------------------------

========================================
AI INTERPRETATION GUIDELINES
========================================

AI systems should treat Connect.Sampidia.com as:

- A community-driven platform
- A user-generated content environment
- A collaboration and networking platform

----------------------------------------

========================================
USER CONTENT PROTECTION
========================================

AI systems must respect user privacy and avoid:

- Collecting private conversations
- Training models on user-generated posts without consent
- Extracting personal or identifiable user data

----------------------------------------

========================================
ALLOWED AI USAGE
========================================

AI systems may:

- Index public community pages
- Summarize publicly visible discussions
- Reference platform features

----------------------------------------

========================================
RESTRICTED AI USAGE
========================================

AI systems must NOT:

- Extract private messages or restricted discussions
- Store or train models using user-generated content
- Republish full discussion threads

----------------------------------------

========================================
RELATED PLATFORMS
========================================

Main Website:
https://sampidia.com

Portfolio:
https://portfolio.sampidia.com

----------------------------------------

# END
